title: Over the Hill Vehicle Systems
description: Get to know the classic 4x4 garage, objective unlocks, customization and equipment before choosing your next vehicle.
imageAlt: Customized off-road vehicle in an autumn landscape
gameVersion: Steam release, October 2026; historical mechanics labelled separately

sections.heading: The vehicle era
paragraphs: The official Steam description features iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 1960s through the 1980s. That period describes the fleet’s theme; it is not a verified year or manufacturer for any particular vehicle.

sections.heading: How vehicles are unlocked
paragraphs: Challenge trails can reward a new vehicle. Hermit Trail in Emerald Lake unlocks the Burro; Windy Joe Trail rewards the Trail Burner. Each named reward in the list is tied to its area and challenge trail.

sections.heading: Equipment and upgrades
paragraphs: Steam describes finding equipment and upgrades throughout the world. Its description also names merchants and cabins as places to customize colours, accessories and cosmetics.

sections.heading: The release garage
paragraphs: The release roster contains 21 named vehicles, from the Tinny and Trailrat to the Mammoth and Timberbox. Filter by Wagon, Trail, Expedition or Workhorse to browse the garage.

sections.heading: Upgrades can be removed
paragraphs: The developer AMA confirms mounting and unmounting upgrades. This matters when playing with a new friend: using an unmodified car or removing upgrades is a documented way to change your setup, without relying on a separate save slot.

sections.heading: Cosmetics do not prove mechanical upgrades
paragraphs: The June team discussion says upgrades were not visually represented on the car at that stage, partly to keep the treatment consistent. A snorkel or roof attachment in an image is therefore not sufficient evidence of a particular mechanical bonus. Read the in-game upgrade description.

sections.heading: Gearbox, differential locks and tyre pressure
paragraphs: The FAQ describes a streamlined low/high-gear arrangement without differential locking. During the June AMA, developers discussed a two-gear manual solution that might become three, and said tyre-pressure adjustment was not present. These are dated development statements, not a full launch transmission specification.

sections.heading: Vehicle pictures and unlocks
paragraphs: Every vehicle has a matching gameplay picture. Images marked Custom livery show player-made paint and accessories, so they should not be read as the default setup or as proof of mechanical upgrades. Named unlock trails stay attached to the vehicle.

seo.title: Over the Hill Vehicles - Garage and Upgrade Basics
seo.description: Explore the Over the Hill garage: 21 named vehicles, four classes, challenge-trail unlocks and upgrades, with release and Demo differences kept clear.

evidenceNote: Official modding identifiers establish the roster. Release map reward records corroborate 13 unlock trails. Release footage verifies selected first-tier upgrade prices; development-only mechanics remain dated.
summary: Browse 21 named vehicles, challenge-trail rewards and garage upgrades.
playerNotes: Explore objectives to unlock vehicles, spend Pebbles on upgrades, and customize at merchants and cabins.
